_comment: Buying committee + message blocks. Vars: {company} {agent_count} {industry_lower} {roi_annual} {roi_per_agent} {trigger_detail} {stakes} {idle_benchmark} {insight_tail} {peer_outcome} {acd} {wfm} {first_name} {seller_first}. Every day-1 email carries four beats: the trigger, the stakes (why now / cost of waiting), a teaching insight with a number that challenges their assumption, and a peer outcome that mirrors them. First touch offers a one-page read (no meeting); the meeting ask is a specific diagnostic in the final touch. Call touches carry two blocks: 'call' is the voicemail, 'call_live' is the live-answer script (opener as a this-or-that risk question tied to the trigger, a 30-second expansion, an interest-based ask, then objection handles). Benchmark and peer numbers come from proof.json and must be verified before sending.
